_comment: MongoDB Atlas Vector Search index definition for the 'lecturechunks' collection. Create this manually in the Atlas UI (Atlas Search -> Create Search Index -> JSON Editor, index type: Vector Search) or via the Atlas Admin API. Do NOT create it from application code. numDimensions (3072) must match EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS in Backend/services/ai/providers/geminiProvider.js (gemini-embedding-001 default output size). Suggested index name: 'lecture_chunk_vector_index'.
